name: yosh-mainnet
description: Connect the existing Yosh Mainnet App authority to Codex without migrating wallet or ledger.

interface.shortDescription: 连接原 Yosh 钱包、API 和共享账本；保留 App 授权。
interface.longDescription: Uses the installed Yosh App backend and existing Codex Agent identity. Mainnet uses real funds. This bridge does not migrate keys, duplicate the ledger, grant authority or replace the App. Manage authorization in Yosh. The isolated local Devnet plugin remains separate.
defaultPrompt: 检查原 Yosh 主网钱包、已注册 API 和授权状态，不付款。
